description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to develop governed HR metrics, validate complex SQL queries, and build interactive executive dashboards for organizational health reporting.
The mandatory requirements are 4+ years, advanced SQL, Snowflake, GitLab, RShiny, Streamlit, R/tidyverse, regression/frequentist stats, explainable code, and upper-intermediate English; Python is preferred, not essential. Posit Connect, People Analytics, Tableau, and agentic analytics are a plus.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Own development of governed, vetted SQL queries of the HR data warehouse, with documentation and unit tests, for up to 36 organizational health metrics and their associated industry benchmarks across 6 pillars: Attract & Hire, Retain, Reward, Grow, Enable Performance, and Uphold Culture.
- Act as lead developer for the associated dashboards, building executive dashboard views for each of the 6 pillars in RShiny that complement the quarterly reporting cadence and the parameterized quarterly report decks.
- Enable self-service exploration of aggregates from the quarterly report by dimensions such as job level, tenure, and job family, and display statistical control limits following the methodology developed by the Data Science team.
- Contribute documentation to the semantic layer in Open Knowledge Format (markdown), written to support both human and agentic workflows.
- Work with Data Engineers to independently vet the accuracy of queries, and with Data Engineers and Data Scientists to clarify requirements and align queries and dashboards with the data model and statistical approach, with a high degree of independence.
- Work in a scrumban team and actively participate in all Agile ceremonies, which are scheduled before 12pm CT.
- Proactively raise blockers, call out unclear requirements, and deliver on time.

MUST HAVES
- 4+ years of experience in a senior-level data analytics role.
- Advanced SQL, including prior experience authoring complex SQL queries.
- Experience with the Snowflake data warehouse and GitLab.
- Code-first dashboard development experience with RShiny and Streamlit. Other dashboard frameworks are not accepted.
- R (tidyverse) as the main programming language.
- College-level statistics through linear regression, including an understanding of frequentist methods.
- Able to explain 100% of their own code without asking an AI agent; AI-assisted code development is encouraged, but vibe coding alone is not sufficient.
- Availability to work Central Time until 12pm. Availability after 12pm CT for greater overlap with other team members would be helpful.
- Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Python programming experience.
- Posit Connect.
- People Analytics or HR experience.
- Tableau (some legacy dashboards are in Tableau).
- Agentic analytics; the team's long-run goal is to allow agentic retrieval and exploration of the governed metrics set.

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
- Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
- Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

Meet Our Recruitment Process
Application → Coding Challenge → Video Interview → Technical Interview or Hiring Manager Interview
Each step helps us understand your skills and overall fit.
If it’s a match, you’ll receive an offer.
